test_BaseLauncher_run: test that BaseLauncher.run raises NotImplementedError when called without a subclass implementation
test_BaseLauncher_get_pid: test that BaseLauncher.get_pid raises NotImplementedError when called without a subclass implementation
test_down_watcher_calls_ondown: test that down_watcher calls the ondown callback when a DOWN ProcInfo event is received
test_down_watcher_skips_up: test that down_watcher does not call the ondown callback when only UP ProcInfo events are received
test_down_watcher_mixed_events: test that down_watcher calls ondown when a DOWN event appears after an UP event in the stream
